name: iam:AddUserToGroup on a privileged-named group (positive)
note: IAM-1005 (suite-2 test 36 / suite-3 test 86): adding a user to a group is an INDIRECT privilege assignment. It must produce the dedicated GROUP-MEMBERSHIP finding at high severity, NOT generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN / AttachUserPolicy / PutUserPolicy. The group's real privilege is inferred from its name (PlatformAdmins) at medium confidence only.
